hardwareHubs.note: Ourspace, a nonprofit production and prototyping studio at 1052 Waimanu Street, lists 3D printing, laser and CNC tools for makers.
NELHA runs the 870-acre Hawaii Ocean Science and Technology Park, a state-run park for ocean, energy and aquaculture technology.

makerspaces.name: Ourspace
makerspaces.note: Site lists 3D printing, laser cutting and engraving, CNC and onsite machine training.

programs.name: Manoa Innovation Center
programs.note: Incubation facility at 2800 Woodlawn Drive that was taken over by the University of Hawaii in 2018 and hosts an electronics tenant, Nalu Scientific.

programs.name: UH Ventures Accelerator
programs.note: Three-month accelerator run by PACE at the Shidler College of Business for founders with a University of Hawaii tie, not specific to hardware.

specialties.name: Ocean science and technology
specialties.note: NELHA's park pipes in deep cold seawater and warm surface seawater for ocean-based and renewable energy demonstration projects.

support.name: INNOVATE Hawaii (HTDC, NIST MEP center)
support.note: Listed as the state's MEP center offering coaching, training and grants, but its page carries a May 16, 2025 notice of discontinuation of federal funding.
